lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple semi-regular horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. The spatial density is highest immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, transitioning to a more sparse distribution towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated intensity are present, creating a non-linear grid where high-luminance blobs serve as intersection nodes. This pattern is partially obscured by surface-refracted light caustics.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from a high-intensity dorsal plane to a low-intensity shadow region directly below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-to-moderate density of high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the lower half and leading edge of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced light caustic patterns (refractive ripple effects) are projected onto the dorsal and lateral surfaces, which modulate the apparent luminance of the underlying pigmentation.
